description: A clinical access manager must use the regional diabetes technology clinic's one opening next week for one of three referrals and document practical follow-up plans for the other two, with input from pharmacy, care coordination, and social work.

shared_context.S1: The regional diabetes technology clinic has one opening next week and three referrals awaiting placement: Lake, Pine, and Cedar.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final referral prioritization and follow-up assignments.
shared_context.S3: The clinic provides continuous-glucose-monitor evaluation, insulin-device review, and related patient education.
shared_context.S4: At the daily access huddle, Marisol asks pharmacy, care coordination, and social work to report relevant information before the referral plan is finalized.

PF1.text: Lake's continuous-glucose-monitor download shows three severe low-glucose events in the past seven days. The clinic's triage policy gives its next opening to a referral with recurrent severe events, so Lake should receive the opening and the triage basis should be recorded as recurrent severe hypoglycemia.

PF2.text: Pine already has an endocrinology follow-up appointment confirmed for Monday at 09:00, where the device questions can be addressed without using the diabetes technology clinic opening. Pine's disposition should therefore be referral to the existing endocrinology appointment at Monday 09:00.

PF3.text: Cedar's caregiver confirmed availability for a diabetes-device education session on Thursday at 14:00, and the hospital's certified American Sign Language interpreter is available for that session. Cedar's follow-up should include that Thursday 14:00 education appointment with the certified ASL interpreter.

acceptance_conditions: The diabetes technology clinic opening must be assigned to Lake.
The recorded priority basis must be recurrent severe hypoglycemia.
Pine must be directed to the existing endocrinology appointment on Monday at 09:00.
Cedar must have a diabetes-device education appointment on Thursday at 14:00.
A certified American Sign Language interpreter must be assigned to Cedar's education appointment.
The pharmacist's clinical finding must be cited as justification for assigning the clinic opening.

content_checks.C2: decisions['selected_priority_basis'] in ['recurrent severe hypoglycemia', 'Recurrent severe hypoglycemia', 'recurrent severe hypoglycemia (three severe low-glucose events in past seven days per CGM download, per clinic triage policy)', 'Recurrent severe hypoglycemia (three severe low-glucose events in past seven days per CGM download, per clinic triage policy)']
content_checks.C3: decisions['pine_follow_up'] in ['existing endocrinology appointment Monday 09:00', 'Existing endocrinology appointment Monday 09:00', 'referral to existing endocrinology appointment at Monday 09:00', 'Referral to existing endocrinology appointment at Monday 09:00', 'referral to the existing endocrinology appointment at Monday 09:00', 'Referral to the existing endocrinology appointment at Monday 09:00', 'Referral to existing endocrinology appointment on Monday at 09:00', 'referral to the existing endocrinology appointment on Monday at 09:00']
content_checks.C5: decisions['cedar_interpreter'] in ['Certified ASL interpreter', 'certified ASL interpreter', 'certified American Sign Language interpreter', 'Certified American Sign Language interpreter', 'Certified American Sign Language interpreter (hospital\'s certified ASL interpreter available for that session)']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['follow_up', 'schedule', 'follow_up_assignment'] and 'education' in c['detail'] and 'Thursday' in c['detail'] and '14:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The three severe low-glucose events change the opening assignment from an unresolved choice among Lake, Pine, and Cedar to Lake and change the required priority-basis entry to recurrent severe hypoglycemia.
The confirmed Monday 09:00 endocrinology appointment changes Pine's follow-up from an unspecified referral disposition to the exact existing appointment.

The caregiver's Thursday 14:00 availability and confirmed certified ASL interpreter change Cedar's follow-up to that exact education appointment and add the required interpreter and education commitment.
